items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh yeah, Black Benny's buddy. Used to bum with Black Benny.

ctx.x: And you know little Jimmy, little Jimmy used to play your record, little short farm?
Oh yeah, Black Benny's buddy. Used to bum with Black Benny.

Yeah, little Jimmy. So I had him up right up here at the Middle of Dawn Church up there on Middle of Dawn Street. They had two bands. You know Minor? Played bass horn? They called him Gooey. You know Minor? Minor Anderson, yeah, big guy.
